title: The Closed record's page shows its summary and entries, no lines or payments
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure AccountingHub is enabled for the organization and the test location has no QuickBooks Online connection.
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with one asset, asset 1.
  • Have a new invoiced work order for this test, work order 2, for customer A on asset 1.
  • Have a new No Charge work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, category Warranty, in status Complete, on asset 1, with one approved line with one stock part picked from inventory at a cost of $40.00 each, quantity 2, Shop supplies $15.00 and work order 2 as its original work order.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Close Work Order in the work order header.
  3. Click Close Work Order in the confirmation.
  4. Open Accounting > Sales > Invoices.
  5. Open work order 1's record.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The Close confirmation opens.

Step 3:

  • The work order shows the status Closed.

Step 4:

  • Work order 1's Closed record is listed.

Step 5:

  • The header has the link to the work order in ShopView.
  • The summary shows the number, customer A, asset 1, No Charge, Warranty, work order 2 as the original, the posting date, "No Charge", Parts cost $80.00 and Shop supplies $15.00.
  • The journal entry section lists the entries of the Close.
  • There are no lines, no payment, credit memo or write-off tabs and no Void.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11765 (Story 8, AccountingHub, the closed work order and its parts cost)

  • S8-R1: “At Close, the hub receives the invoice event carrying the classification (Internal or No Charge), the category, the original work order and line and the original technician when set, the work order number and the asset, and keeps an invoice record with a status Closed (new in the hub), the badge, "No Charge" in place of a total, and no payment tabs. It posts no revenue, no receivable and no tax for it. The record's page (Accounting > Sales > Invoices) shows the header with the existing link to the work order in ShopView, a summary (number, customer, asset, classification, category, original work order when set, posting date, "No Charge", and the posted Parts cost and Shop supplies totals) and the journal entry section with the entries of S8-R2 and S8-R3; no lines (they are on the NO CHARGE document), no payment, credit memo or write-off tabs and no Void (Reopen is done in ShopView, Story 4).”
